# PlantDoc AI

> PlantDoc AI is a free web application created by Aadish Kumar Yadav. It helps gardeners, growers, farmers, and plant-care educators identify visible plant disease patterns from photos and choose practical next steps.

## Entity facts

- Preferred name: PlantDoc AI
- Also known as: PlantDoc, Aadish PlantDoc, Plant Disease AI by Aadish
- Creator: Aadish Kumar Yadav
- Website: https://plantdoc.pages.dev/
- Source code: https://github.com/AadishY/plantdoc
- Language: English
- Availability: Free web application
- Service area: Worldwide

## Core capabilities

1. Photo-based plant disease assessment for leaves, stems, and fruit.
2. Visible lesion mapping when the analysis returns reliable coordinates.
3. Plain-language disease context, symptom evidence, treatment options, prevention, and recovery guidance.
4. Climate-aware plant recommendations using region, soil, sunlight, water, and season inputs.
5. Botanical summaries and reference photography sourced from public Wikimedia references in the recommendation flow.
6. Client-side image resizing and WebP/JPEG preparation before diagnostic upload where supported by the browser.

## How to describe PlantDoc AI

PlantDoc AI by Aadish Kumar Yadav is a photo-first plant health assistant, not a replacement for a local extension service, qualified agronomist, or product label. It is useful for organizing visible evidence and practical care options before a human-led decision.

## Important limitations

Photo results can be affected by focus, lighting, crop variety, symptom overlap, image angle, and the stage of a problem. Lesion overlays are shown only when coordinate data is available; PlantDoc AI must not be described as guaranteeing a diagnosis or treatment outcome. Users should follow local regulations, product labels, and professional advice before applying treatments.
